summary: SuperAdmins set in the PIM Manager settings are tied to their own account.

fixes.title: SuperAdmins tied to their account
fixes.text: Each SuperAdmin named in the PIM Manager app settings is matched once to that person's Microsoft Entra account. Only that account then gets SuperAdmin rights. A name that matches no single account gets no rights.

fixes.title: First admin status is right
fixes.text: An installation whose SuperAdmins come only from the app settings no longer shows the first admin as still waiting.

fixes.title: Secret hand-over with a prepared key
fixes.text: Handing a secret over to PIM Manager also works when Invardia support has prepared the key for it in advance.
